vehicle: VANGUARD-03: unmanned Marvel-inspired exploration probe about two metres across, tangible scientific machine rather than superhero costume. Low hexagonal deep-crimson body, flat graphite deck, satin-gold inset side panels. NO wheels. Three identical downward pulse-thruster housings form a balanced triangle firmly integrated beneath the body; fictional pulse lift enables low hover. Three short hinged landing legs attach around the lower rim with broad footpads clear of the outlets. One short central camera mast carries a dark lens block. One compact two-joint sampling arm attaches to a distinct FRONT panel, folded against it for travel; opposite rear panel plain. Matte red paint, dark heat-resistant nozzle rims, lightly brushed gold panels and tidy recessed fasteners. No cockpit, floating components, giant energy core or weapons.

mission.name: Far Reach Demonstrator
mission.purpose: Reach crater terrain inaccessible to wheels using experimental pulse lift.
mission.arrival: A robotic carrier releases the probe near a small crater.
mission.fiction_boundary: Pulse lift is invented; visible supports, shadows and dust interaction must remain coherent.
